title: Release notes
description: Human-written notes for one runtime spec or one stable Python release. .github/scripts/check-release-notes.py enforces this schema. Do not put wasm hashes, commit SHAs, or generated URLs here. The announce script adds those at post time.

spec_version.description: Required when kind is runtime. Must match the file name runtime/<spec>.json.

packages.description: Required when kind is python. Exactly bittensor and bittensor-core. The file name is python/<bittensor version>.json.

page_path.description: Repository path of an existing page.tsx under website/apps/bittensor-website/src/app/(pages-without-footer)/releases/<slug>/.

public_path.description: Site path. Must be /releases/<slug> for the same folder as page_path.

install_commands.description: Legacy field accepted for old notes. Announcements generate their install commands.

summary.description: Prose a person wrote. The model may shorten this text. It may not add versions, hashes, or URLs.
